name: m3
description: Give Antigravity a private memory that lives on your own machine — it remembers across sessions, works fully offline, and uses the cloud only if you choose to. 100+ MCP tools: fast hybrid search, automatic chat capture, contradiction tracking, and one-command GDPR export/delete.

capture_mode.title: Chatlog capture mode
capture_mode.description: Which hooks fire chatlog ingest. One of: both | stop | precompact | none. 'both' = Stop + PreCompact (recommended). Validated by mcp-memory at runtime; invalid values fall back to 'both'.
